simple.meaning: כַּבִּיר (kabbîyr) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “vast , whether in extent (figuratively, of power, mighty ; of time, aged ), or in number, many.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 10 times across Job, Isaiah, beginning at Job 8:2. Its meaning is built by comparing the passages where Scripture uses it.

simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.

structuredEvidence.definition: vast , whether in extent (figuratively, of power, mighty ; of time, aged ), or in number, many

firstOccurrence.englishText: “How long will you speak these things?

timeline.evidenceText: “How long will you speak these things?
With us are both the gray-headed and the very aged men,
If I have rejoiced because my wealth was great,
Should even one who hates justice govern?
He breaks mighty men in pieces in ways past finding out,
“Behold, God is mighty, and doesn’t despise anyone.
“Behold, God is mighty, and doesn’t despise anyone.

But now Yahweh has spoken, saying, “Within three years, as a worker bound by contract would count them, the glory of Moab shall be brought into contempt, with all his great multitude; and the remnant will be very small and feeble.”
Ah, the uproar of many peoples, who roar like the roaring of the seas; and the rushing of nations, that rush like the rushing of mighty waters!
Behold, the Lord has a mighty and strong one. Like a storm of hail, a destroying storm, and like a storm of mighty waters overflowing, he will cast them down to the earth with his hand.

definitions.full: H3524. kabbir כַּבִּיר adjective great, mighty, much only in poetry, and only Job, Isa 1 : — Isa 10:13 Qr (but read as Kt כְּאַבִּיר ), 17:12 ; and 28:2 כבירים מים (usually רַבִּים מַיִם ), Job 8:2 פיך אמרי כביר ורוח a mighty wind, 15:10 ימים מאביך כביר (Ges § 131 , R 5a) = aged: of God, 34:17 צַדִּיק כַּבִּיר the just mighty one, 36:5 a, v b ׳כ לֵב כֹּחַ mighty in strength of understanding; 34:24 כבירים mighty men ; of quantity = much , Isa 16:14 כַבִּיר לוֺא מִזְעָר מְעַט שְׁאָר , Job 31:25 ידי מצאה כביר וכי had gotten much.
